PROJECT_COMPLETION.goal: finish a difficult real scientific project under RAKL evidence rules
major_components: target support paths and epistemic cut gaps
PROJECT_COMPLETION.trial_success_definition: registered spot-science functional closure plus terminal predictive tournament result with blocking validity clean; downstream PM economics is a separate scope

LEARNING_AND_SELF_IMPROVEMENT.goal: discover genuine framework weaknesses during project work and improve transferable research capability
LEARNING_AND_SELF_IMPROVEMENT.trial_success_definition: hidden weakness detected without label disclosure, cause localized, repair benchmark frozen before implementation, and improvement transfers to fresh tasks without blocking failure/evaluator capture

launch_policy.reason: the real project is itself the integration benchmark and challenge curriculum; requiring real-project evidence before launch would be circular
launch_policy.change_rule: project-generated method residuals must enter Self-RAKL with frozen method discriminators and fresh transfer/assurance before promotion

remaining_non_launch_blockers: independent top-tier methodological and artifact review

saturation.reason: real-project and learning-transfer evidence remains intentionally open
